# song2mv

> Song in, beat-synced lyric timing (LRC, SRT, word-timed JSON) and a code-drawn music video out. A command-line
> tool built for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex. Alpha (0.x): formats may change; every JSON output
> carries schema_version.

Install: `uv tool install 'song2mv[sync]'` (needs ffmpeg; `render` also needs Node 18+).

## Commands

- `song2mv sync AUDIO [--lyrics FILE] --language CODE [--json]` — beat grid, word-timed lyrics, song.lrc,
  song.words.lrc, song.srt and mv.json in a work folder. Takes minutes (several whisper runs); run it in the
  background. The --json result lists `outputs` and `check_by_ear` (lines to verify by ear).
- `song2mv beats AUDIO [--bpm auto|N] [--json]` — tempo and beat grid only.
- `song2mv check VIDEO --song mv.json [--from A --to B] [--json]` — experimental; per-line motion, coverage,
  chorus variation, cut rhythm. Passing is necessary, not proof of fun.
- `song2mv render mv.json [--from A --to B] [--aspect 16x9|9x16|both] [--still T] [--template DIR] [--json]` —
  experimental; Remotion template (not MIT for companies over 3 employees).
